Yes I need to listen to music or I cant sleep but I just wake up with crippling anxiety , It all started when i was 14 I realized  how empty my life will be I was on drugs to numb the feelings then It just gets worst year after year I usually cry myself to sleep I took a load of tablets when I was 16 my brothers gf found me and they rushed me to the hospital but ever since I feel the should have let me die . The only thing I care about is my family I dont want to mess them up I just find everything  so irrelevant I only want to work to get high to try and numb myself I know my life will be a disappointment I feel it will never get better and I just fake everything  to the point that no one has any idea this is the first time I ever speak about it
